descriptive_title: Grade 3 Mathematics: Numbers — Reading, Composing, Comparing, Rounding, and Counting Numbers to 1000, plus Fair-Sharing Up to 20 Items and Equivalent Fractions (B1.1–B1.7)
short_description: A 5-day Ontario Grade-3 unit on Numbers (B1.1-B1.7) framed around 'Fraction Street' — Frankie the Fraction Friend, Penny the Place Value Pal, and Sammy the Sharer. Numbers to 1000, rounding, fair-sharing up to 20 items, and equivalent fractions all in one focused week.
long_description: Children spend a focused week as Junior Fraction Friends. Day 1 'House 1000' opens with thousands place value (B1.1, B1.5). Day 2 'Compare and Order on Fraction Street' extends comparison to 1000 with skip-counting (B1.2, B1.4). Day 3 'The Rounding House' teaches rounding to nearest 10 or 100 with the number-line jump strategy (B1.3). Day 4 'Sharing Up to 20' tackles fair-share with up to 10 sharers including mixed numbers (B1.6). Day 5 'Equivalent Fractions' is the capstone: fraction strip stacking and pizza overlays prove 1/2 = 2/4 = 4/8, 1/3 = 2/6, 1/5 = 2/10 (B1.7). Each lesson includes a 4000+ char expanded_walkthrough covering 3 misconceptions with paired recovery moves.
what_is_included: 5 fully-scripted lesson plans with 50-minute durations and 250 minutes of total teaching time
5 student worksheets aligned to each lesson with name/date fields and child-voice learning goals
1 mid-unit formative assessment (Number-and-Rounding Check-In) administered between Lessons 3 and 4

13 printable teacher manipulatives plus 3 character puppets: base-ten blocks (with thousand-cubes) label, place-value mat with thousands, 0-1000 number street (11 letter pages), 24 compare cards, 24 rounding jump cards, 20 paper treats, 8 fraction strips per pair, 10 share plates label, equivalence pizza cards, the Fraction Street anchor poster, plus stick-puppet variants of Frankie, Penny, and Sammy
1 end-of-unit reflection sheet with 5 self-assessment prompts
1 seven-row summative rubric covering B1.1-B1.7 across 4 levels
1 summative-administration guide tying the rubric to Lesson 5 worksheet
Junior Fraction Friend certificate (one per child)

Detailed expanded walkthroughs for every lesson including the zero-placeholder repair, cross-thousand comparison repair, wrong-place rounding repair, leftover-fraction calculation repair, and additive equivalence misconception repair
Differentiation tracks built into every lesson: emerging learners, extending learners, ELL/IEP, and movement-first learners
target_buyer: Ontario Grade 3 teachers covering the B1.1-B1.7 cluster of the 2026 Grade 3 Math curriculum.
subject: Mathematics
pedagogical_approach: CRA progression. Real base-ten blocks (incl. thousand-cubes), fraction strips, paper treats, and equivalence pizzas anchor every concept. Lesson 1 introduces thousands-place; Lesson 2 extends comparison to 1000; Lesson 3 introduces rounding via the number-line jump; Lesson 4 fair-shares with up to 10 sharers and mixed numbers; Lesson 5 reveals equivalent fractions through strip stacking and pizza overlays. Differentiation is proactive.
